headline: EU Introduces Two-Euro Fee on Non-Bloc Parcels to Curb Inflows
summary: The European Union imposed a two-euro ($2.25) handling fee on packages from outside the 27-nation bloc, aiming to curb the influx from China.
why: Cross-border e-commerce tariffs and customs levies directly impact transport costs, retail margins, and global trade volumes.

impacts.name: European E-Commerce
impacts.why: The new handling charge raises costs on low-value consumer imports entering the European Union.
